summary: A planned master change receipt settles as succeeded only through its own hand-over, not because the target later became master by another operation.

guide.reason: An unconfirmed master change now reports when the target became master through another operation.

api.reason: Only the Core-local settlement of an existing command receipt changes; no request, response or contract changes.

roadmap.reason: Fix inside the existing master-change settlement.

state.record: The old master's durable pool-peer transfer record (source role, operation id, stage done) and its command journal.
state.reason: Both already exist on the host; a fresh Controller reads the receipt result from the host.

verification.method: Focused Go tests in internal/agent; the new test fails without the check. No lab run.
